title: Director of Pricing
description:
**Role Profile:** Director of Pricing
  
  

COMPANY OVERVIEW
  
  

At World of Books, we’re on a mission to become the Planet’s Bookstore.
  
  

Our business was founded in 2002 with the purpose of encouraging recycling, minimising waste and fostering sustainability by giving books a second life. Since then, we’ve grown into the world’s largest seller of used books, providing millions of customers with an affordable way to discover, purchase and enjoy books sustainably.
  
  

We now operate across the UK, US and Hungary, with over 1,000 employees and a certified B\-Corp status that reflects our commitment to doing good, protecting the environment and supporting charitable causes.
  
  

**Our lines of business:**  

**World of Books:** The UK’s largest online retailer of used (and new!) books, reaching customers in over 190 countries through direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) channels, marketplaces (e.g. Amazon and eBay) and wholesale partners.
  
  

**World of Rare Books:** Specialists in rare, vintage and first edition books, providing one of Europe’s largest collections of pre\-ISBN and decorative vintage books.
  
  

**Sell Your Books (SYB):** An innovative app\-based service enabling customers to scan barcodes or tap ISBN codes from their books for instant valuations and hassle\-free resale.
  
  

**World of Books Enterprise:** A SaaS product capable of scanning products on an industrial level, enabling organisations such as national charities to sell us their books, generate additional revenue for good causes and allow more items to be reused.
  
  

We’ve scaled profitably and at pace in recent years and in August 2021 we attracted investment from Livingbridge, a leading mid\-market private equity firm, to further accelerate our growth.
  
  

Today, we’re generating revenue in excess of £200 million per annum, driven by continued investment in our commercial, technology and data capabilities. Our dynamic pricing engine sits at the heart of this, enabling us to optimise value for customers while maximising sales and margin across every channel.
  
  

ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  

As Director of Pricing, you will play a critical role in shaping and executing our global pricing strategy across multiple geographies, products and sales channel. Your remit will cover the entire pricing lifecycle – from purchasing inventory to selling it – and span multiple business models; including D2C, marketplaces and wholesale.
  
  

This is a rare opportunity to drive both strategic direction and day\-to\-day commercial performance in a fast\-moving, data\-rich environment with significant headroom for growth.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

**You will have ultimate accountability for the following areas:**
  
  

**What books we buy, and in what quantity:**  

Define which books to acquire and in what volume, using data\-led forecasting and customer demand signals to inform our sourcing strategy.
  
  

Lead the use of predictive modelling and optimisation tools to determine what inventory will maximise sales, margin, and customer satisfaction;
  
  

Establish and manage the objective functions that govern sourcing and inventory decisions, ensuring the business continuously optimises for commercial and customer outcomes.
  
  

**How much we pay for books:**  

Own the logic and infrastructure behind buy\-price algorithms for all sourcing channels, including selective and bulk acquisitions from consumers and charity partners.
  
  

Lead a cross\-functional squad, including pricing analysts, data scientists, engineers and product managers, to develop and evolve algorithms that accurately reflect value, demand and conversion potential.
  
  

Use revenue management techniques to continuously evaluate and refine buy\-side pricing, identifying both risks and opportunities.
  
  

Implement A/B tests and pricing experiments to evaluate the impact of changes to buy prices and refine inputs over time.
  
  

What price we set on books for each selling channel (including promotions and shipping fees):
  
  

Own the strategy for all products and conditions (new, used, rare) across all sales channels (D2C, marketplaces, wholesale), ensuring we remain competitive while delivering strong unit economics.
  
  

Design, deliver and maintain a clear pricing roadmap, balancing long\-term structural improvements to systems with short\-term tactical pricing rule changes to optimise revenue and margin.
  
  

Lead and design the execution of dynamic and rules\-based pricing engines, incorporating real\-time data on demand elasticity, inventory position, seasonality, competitor pricing and customer behaviour.
  
  

Shape promotional pricing, shipping models and bundling strategies that drive conversion, customer lifetime value and profitable growth.
  
  

**Which channels we sell books on:**  

Determine the optimal sales route for each item, based on commercial performance, platform economics and product characteristics.
  
  

Define and maintain automated channel\-allocation logic, ensuring each item is listed in the most commercially effective channel.
  
  

Work cross\-functionally to ensure pricing and channel decisions are operationally scalable and aligned to strategic growth targets.
  
  

Collaborate with performance marketing and CRM teams to use pricing as a lever to support broader trading performance.
  
  

**Which books to keep in inventory:**  

Set clear pricing\-led rules for managing stock across its lifecycle – from initial listing to markdown, reprice or removal.
  
  

Build frameworks that assess when items should be retained, discounted or culled, based on factors such as age, sales velocity, warehouse capacity and space economics.
  
  

Use tactical pricing levers to optimise trading performance and reduce slow\-moving stock.
  
  

Act as product owner for pricing and inventory infrastructure, ensuring systems, tools and cross\-functional delivery processes are aligned with the commercial strategy.
  
  

Within your first year in the role, we anticipate that you will have demonstrated excellent progress towards the following key milestones and deliverables:
  
  

Implementing pricing A/B testing to maximise profitability, with an initial focus on increasing average sale price, items per order, average order value and unit profit for our most popular books.
  
  

Building effective monitoring and reporting of inputs and outputs of pricing changes, including internal, competitive and macro variables.
  
  

Delivering consistent, logical observed pricing that matches expected outcome from documented and communicated rules.
  
  

Collaborating with the Pricing Product Team, including data scientists, engineers and analysts, to rapidly test, run and deploy new pricing algorithms across all our buying and selling channels.
  
  

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
  
  

**Key experience:**  

Proven leadership experience in pricing, revenue management or commercial strategy in an eCommerce, marketplace, or high\-SKU environment (N.B. we have millions of SKUs). Exposure to long\-tail or catalogue\-based retailing (e.g. books, media, consumer goods) would be particularly advantageous.
  
  

Strong track record of designing and executing pricing strategies using machine learning and reinforcement learning techniques – particularly those suited to high\-velocity, multi\-product environments (e.g. multi\-armed bandit approaches).
  
  

Demonstrated success working alongside data science, analytics and engineering teams to develop and refine pricing logic and automation.
  
  

Proven ability to simplify and communicate complex pricing mechanisms in layman's terms, enabling understanding and alignment across non\-technical stakeholders and business leaders.
  
  

Experience leading pricing strategy across direct\-to\-consumer and third\-party marketplaces (e.g. Amazon, eBay), with a deep understanding of platform\-specific pricing dynamics.
  
  

Exposure to international pricing and localisation, particularly across UK and US markets.
  
  

Proficiency in SQL and Python.
  
  

**Key attributes:**  

Outstanding leadership skills, with the ability to inspire, motivate and empower teams to perform at a high level and drive business success.
  
  

A strategic thinker who can solve complex problems creatively and critically, while remaining agile and comfortable with ambiguity and change.
  
  

Strong focus on results, with the ability to set clear goals and deliver at pace in a dynamic, trading\-led environment.
  
  

Strong financial and commercial acumen, with a deep understanding of how pricing decisions impact the wider business.
  
  

High energy, ambition, and resilience; the capacity to operate with urgency and maintain momentum under pressure.
  
  

Excellent influencing and communication skills, with the confidence to negotiate, challenge constructively and build alignment across diverse stakeholders.
  
  

LOCATION
  
  

London (\~3 days a week), with some travel to our other offices in the UK (Coventry and West Sussex), US (Illinois) and Hungary on an ad hoc basis.
  
  

WHY JOIN WORLD OF BOOKS?
  
  

We believe in building great things with great people. As a values\-driven organisation, we:
  
  

Work as one team, fostering collaboration across all functions.
  
  

Are customer\-obsessed, ensuring everything we build delivers value.
  
  

Simplify, move fast, and deliver results, embracing agility and innovation.
  
  

Protect the environment, making sustainability the core of everything we do.
  
  

This is an opportunity to lead game\-changing innovation in our marketplace, shaping how millions of books are bought and sold every year.

title: Data Director
description:
**Job Description**  

We're transforming our use data and reaching a pivotal point in the demand for data insights from our businesses! We're now looking for a driven data leader to transform AJ Bell’s use of data and lead its data function through this transformation. Data at AJ Bell needs to reflect our strategic market positioning of “ease of use,” “trust” and “low\-cost.”


We are therefore hiring a Data Director to lead and collaborate with our data functions, encompassing data analytics, data science, data governance, and data engineering. You will deliver our vision using data to provide a market\-leading platform service, driving value from data. You will drive a data\-first culture, empowering self\-service approaches across the business, underpinned by technology, governance, and data science capabilities. The data team will provide insights that drive improved strategic outcomes for our business; using data as the foundation for all we do.


The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical grounding, track record of problem solving, commercial acumen and experience in a senior role leading data teams.

**What does the job involve?**

**Strategy**

* Develop and implement data strategies and initiatives to support the company's overall goals and objectives, driving value from data.
* Engage with key stakeholders across the business to understand their data needs and ensure alignment with business objectives. Adopt a value\-led approach, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to identify and prioritise data needs and requirements.
* Act as an evangelist for data across the business, to empower a data\-driven culture. Whether through training or data democratisation, data is the lifeblood of our business. Promote data literacy across the organisation, ensuring that all employees understand the value of data and how to use it effectively.
* Innovation: Identifying opportunities to unlock hidden value, supporting new product/service development and/or data monetisation

**Analytics and AI**

* Oversight of data analyst and data scientist capabilities, to create high\-performing teams through guidance, support, and mentorship of the Head of Data Insights.
* Analytics and Business Intelligence: Drawing valuable insights from data to support decision\-making, both in ad\-hoc reporting and ongoing services (dashboard etc).
* Manage change related to data initiatives, ensuring smooth transitions and adoption of new data processes and technologies.
* Drive the adoption of advanced analytics and AI to enhance business capabilities and outcomes (owning AI for data and supporting AI in tech services).
* Leverage data to gain deeper customer insights, improving customer experience and personalisation.
* Establish innovation labs or centres of excellence within the data team to explore innovative technologies and methodologies.

**Governance**

* Governance \& Data Management: Oversight of data quality, governance, master data management, and policy in a data context. Ensure the responsibility for data accuracy though the development of data quality metrics.
* Oversight of the identification, management, and ownership of data risk, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards. Ensure ethical use of data, including adherence to privacy laws and ethical guidelines in data science and AI.

**Data engineering**

* Collaborate with engineering teams in the collection, storage, and analysis of data to ensure accuracy, integrity, and security.
* Strengthen collaboration with IT teams to ensure that data infrastructure supports business needs and is scalable for future growth. Structure and design of data in Snowflake platform to ensure it meets the needs of the business.

**Management**

* Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to data initiatives and their impact on business performance. Develop and track performance metrics related to data initiatives, ensuring they contribute to business success.
* Manage relationships with external data vendors and partners, ensuring they deliver value and meet AJ Bell’s standards.
* Develop training programs to upskill employees in data analytics, data science and data governance.
* Manage the budget for data initiatives, ensuring efficient use of resources.
* Promotes a workplace that is inclusive and diverse where everyone feels respected and included.
* Act as a role model for organisational values and leadership behaviours.
* Lead, inspire, and manage a team of data professionals.
* Supporting and enabling the business to achieve its regulatory requirements, including consumer duty.

**What we're looking for:**

* Demonstrated leadership in data strategy and execution, with a track record of delivering data initiatives aligned to business goals.
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high\-performing teams across data analytics, data science, governance, and engineering.
* Proven track record of leading data\-driven transformation, using analytics to unlock measurable business impact, enable data\-led decisions, inform product development, and enhance customer insight. Ability to ensure scalable, secure, and reliable data infrastructure that enables lifecycle analytics and supports revenue and growth objectives.
* Expertise in analytical and querying tools such as Python, SAS, or SQL.
* Ability to promote a data\-first culture by improving data understanding, accessibility, and confidence across the organisation, while championing the strategic value of data in achieving business goals. Ability to demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous learning, staying ahead of evolving data technologies and industry trends to maintain best practice and support ongoing improvements. Ability to maintain strategic vision, coupled with attention to detail.
* Customer\-focused, with a detailed understanding of relevant legislation and regulation.
* Adaptable to a constantly changing data and business environment, with the ability to pivot strategies in response to innovative technologies, insights, or regulatory developments. Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and big data technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Spark).
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to distil complex data concepts into clear messages for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross functional collaboration skills with the ability to build rapport at all levels.
* Previous experience in financial services or other highly regulated sectors is advantageous.

**About us**


AJ Bell is one of the fastest\-growing investment platform businesses in the UK offering an award\-winning range of solutions that caters for everyone, from professional financial advisers to DIY investors with little to no experience. **The Team**
 This role is part of a well\-established Enterprise Security team, who lead in the design, implementation and troubleshooting of IT security solutions across a variety of technical platforms, data networks and security domains. The solutions involved underpin the organisation’s corporate, market and power system operational functions.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking an experience Cyber Data Scientist to join our Enterprise Security function. This pivotal role focuses on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) techniques to automate and optimise cybersecurity practices, advance threat detection and protection capabilities across the organisation. The role will develop advanced security dashboards and define key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement data\-driven strategies that enhance our governance, compliance and incident response capabilities. By collaborating with cross\-functional teams and providing strategic insights, this role will significantly strengthen our cybersecurity posture and enhance our operational resilience in a highly dynamic threat environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Cybersecurity Data Governance: Define and implement data governance frameworks that ensure reliable, accurate, and timely cybersecurity data for Cyber Governance, Risk and Compliance initiatives.

* Data Visualisation: Employ advanced data visualisation techniques to present complex cybersecurity data insights clearly, facilitating informed decision making among stakeholders.
* Advanced Data Analytics and Modelling: Employ advanced AL and ML techniques to analyse complex datasets from sources such as EDR, SIEM and vulnerability scanners, identifying patterns, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats that inform strategic cybersecurity decisions and risk assessments at the enterprise level.
* Anomaly Detection: Develop threat detection use cases, anomaly detection systems and predictive models to identify malicious activity or security operational risk indicators.
* Threat Detection: Contribute to the development of threat intelligence platforms by modelling adversary behaviours.
* Automation of Governance Processes: Lead the development of automated systems and workflows to streamline security governance practices, risk assessments, compliance monitoring and incident response, improving efficiency and reducing response times.
* Security Policy Development: Utilize AI tools to evaluate and monitor compliance with security policies against network behaviours, automating compliance checks and reporting any discrepancies.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cybersecurity analysts, engineers and business units to align data\-driven insights with security initiatives, validate and improve detections and automate response workflows.
* Policy Development and Compliance: Support the formulation and implementation of cybersecurity policies that are informed by data analytics, ensuring that compliance requirements and best practices are met across the organisation.
* Training and Knowledge Sharing: Mentor and train team members on advanced data science techniques and the utilisation of analytics tools, fostering a knowledgeable workforce aligned with the cyber strategy and governance objectives.
* Continuous Improvement and Innovation: Stay abreast of the latest trends in AI, ML and cybersecurity to enhance methodologies and tools used in governance processes. Proactively seek opportunities to innovate and improve existing practices.


**Essential**
**About You**
* Bachelor’s or master's degree in Cybersecurity, Data Science, Computer Science or a related field
* Proficiency in algorithms, frameworks, and tools for building and training ML models.
* Strong coding abilities in languages such as Python, Java and R, with hands\-on experience in data manipulation, analysis, and machine learning model development.
* Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) for creating intuitive dashboards that translate4 complex data into actionable insights.

**Desirable**

 Have you ever wondered why it's taking so long for an earner to be matched to your trip, why the ETA is so long, or how an Earner is picked from the many around you? If so, the Mobility Matching Science team is for you!

We work on the problems of determining which earners to send an offer to and when. The solutions we build are critical for maintaining reliability and ensuring the trust of riders and earners alike.

* Ph.D., M.S. or Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathemathics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, or other quantitative fields.
* Minimum 1 year of industry experience as an Applied or Data Scientist or equivalent.
* Proficient in Python/R to able to work efficiently at scale with large datasets

The Product Manager is responsible for overall team product direction and strategy, and will involve frequent collaboration with customers and internal teams to help shape priorities and build the roadmap.


You’ll lead a product team that includes design, content, user experience research, engineering, and quality specialists to focus on bridging the gap between inexperienced staff and exceptional dining experiences.


You’ll do this by:

* Strategically using AI across both the product itself and the product development lifecycle to accelerate your work, your team’s work, and bring our customers the most impactful, efficient, and flexible tools to help them run their business.


The Product Manager Role:

* Managing the discovery, research, and design phases of both the foundational data layers and their integration into multiple product touchpoints (POS, KDS, Pulse).
* Expertly executing the Product Development and Software Development lifecycles to effectively launch and scale both 0 to 1 and incremental products.
* Defining, tracking, reporting on, and iteratively responding to key performance indicators related to table pacing, guest satisfaction, and revenue impacts.

You love rolling your sleeves up to build things that solve problems. You thrive in ambiguity, and "being in the weeds" (within reason) is exciting for you. You're analytical and intuitive, and adeptly juggle both to make decisions that inspire confidence. Specifically, you have:

* About 4 years of experience leading a Product team that owns a domain of functionality, with a preference for having built products 0 to 1\.
* Experience with data\-driven products for customer\-facing (not internal business tooling) applications, particularly in operational contexts that impact end\-user experiences.

* The technical fluency to collaborate effectively with engineers and data scientists on complex data models and real\-time information exchange between systems.
* A strong point of view on how data should be communicated to the end\-user.
* A proven track record of launching products with positive, measurable business outcomes.
* The ability to approach problems with an empathetic lens, balancing data\-driven decision making with a genuine understanding of – and intuition for – the solutions that our restaurant customers will love most.
* Demonstrated ability to understand and engage with multiple functional areas of the business – engineering, design, finance, sales, support, and marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead without authority. You can tell a story that others understand and are excited by.
* An ownership\-approach to problem solving – the ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using all the resources available to you.


How You'll Know You're Successful

* Engineers and designers have a north star and are aligned and excited. They understand the "why" and the "what" of your roadmap.
* Lightspeed colleagues are excited about what the team has delivered and what is coming up on the roadmap.
* You're contributing to measurable success across key business metrics defined in collaboration with your manager and with the team.


What’s in it for you?


Come live the Lightspeed experience...

* Lots of autonomy, flexible work culture and the option of fully remote work
* Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day
* Opportunity to make a difference; help merchants grow their businesses and become more successful by creating or improving products and addressing customer feedback

* Opportunities to learn and expand your skill set

A city is a complex system where people and organizations interact and make decisions about land\-use in a social, environmental, and economic context. Auckland Council has a responsibility to prescribe land\-use, provide infrastructure, and regulate certain activities for the benefit of all Aucklanders. To support this, Auckland Council’s Strategist Unit is developing (in partnership with a vendor) an agent\-based modelling system to model how the decisions that Auckland Council makes affects how the Auckland Region develops over time.



The Strategist Unit is building its capability and capacity to build, enhance and maintain this land\-use modelling system. We are recruiting for one or more Senior Data Scientists to join the team.



This is an opportunity to be part of the development of cutting\-edge technology that will have a tangible impact on the future of Auckland, driving evidence\-based decision\-making and resource allocation.



This is a critical role for the Council and will focus on the development of the land\-use model over the next three years while gaining a code\-level understanding of the system sufficient for the team to be able to operate, maintain and enhance the model after the three\-year build\-out period.



You could expect to work on:



* Prototyping data assets, data pipelines, statistical or economic models, or similar.
* Conceptual designs for land\-use model components.
* Statistical or economic analysis in Statistics NZs microdata environment (IDI/LBD).
* Translating business needs into technical requirements for the land\-use model.
* The operation, maintenance, troubleshooting and enhancement of the land\-use model, and supporting the organization’s use of outputs.

  


**He kōrero mōu: About you**



This role requires experience in data science or quantitative research, ideally with some experience in software development. You will have experience in similar roles within large, complex, or political organisations, or in organizations that cater to large, complex or political organizations.

* Knowledge and expertise in data science, coding in at least one of Python, R, or Julia, ideally in an Agile process with modern version control tools.

title: Database Developer
description:
### **About Us**



Le Autos Group Limited is a multi\-branch vehicle dealership based in Auckland, specialising in high\-quality used Japanese and European vehicles. With an inventory of over 250 cars, comprehensive in\-house finance offerings, and an expanding online and physical customer base, we rely heavily on technology and data to drive our daily operations. We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented **Database Developer** to enhance, maintain, and secure our data systems.

### **Position Overview**



The Database Developer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust, scalable, and secure database systems that support Le Autos’ internal applications and online platforms. The role involves analysing business requirements, programming database solutions, integrating systems across multiple branches, and ensuring high data availability, consistency, and security. Additionally, the role will leverage artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) techniques to develop advanced data\-driven solutions that enhance business performance.

  


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Develop and maintain the company’s central database systems to support dealership operations, including vehicle inventory management, customer records, finance applications, and sales tracking.


* Design and optimise data solutions that power the company's online vehicle listings, ensuring real\-time accuracy of stock availability, pricing, and specifications across all branches.


* Build and support integration between internal systems (sales, admin, finance) and external platforms such as the company website, finance partner portals, and CRM tools to streamline operations and reduce manual work.


* Analyse sales, customer, and operational data to support business decisions — such as pricing strategies, marketing effectiveness, inventory turnover, and finance approval trends.



Automate data processes (e.g., vehicle listing updates, application status tracking, lead follow\-up alerts) to improve staff efficiency and customer response time.


* Create data\-driven reporting tools and dashboards for management, covering performance indicators such as monthly sales, branch comparisons, finance conversion rates, and customer engagement.


* Leverage AI and machine learning techniques to develop predictive analytics models that forecast vehicle demand, optimise inventory levels, and enhance customer targeting strategies.


* Implement data mining and natural language processing (NLP) algorithms to analyse customer feedback, online enquiries, and social media sentiment, providing actionable insights for sales and marketing teams.


* Automate routine data processing tasks using AI\-powered tools and scripts to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual errors.


* Collaborate with data scientists or external AI consultants to integrate AI solutions with existing database and CRM systems.


* Diagnose and resolve data\-related issues, bugs, and inconsistencies quickly to minimise disruption to sales and customer service.


* Ensure data security and compliance by implementing appropriate user access controls, backups, and storage procedures in line with New Zealand privacy laws.


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date technical documentation to ensure systems can be supported and upgraded efficiently.


* Collaborate closely with sales consultants, finance managers, admin staff, and management to continuously improve the database systems in line with the company’s business needs.


### **Skills \& Qualifications**



Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.



Or, at least 5 years’ hands\-on experience in database development, preferably in a commercial or retail environment.



Strong command of SQL and experience with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Microsoft SQL Server.



Experience in integrating databases with web\-based systems and APIs.



Familiarity with backend programming languages (e.g. Python, PHP, Node.js) and their interaction with databases.



Knowledge of database performance optimisation and indexing strategies.



Understanding of data security, access control, and compliance with NZ data privacy laws.



Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.



Strong communication and documentation skills.


### **Why Join Us**



At Le Autos, we believe technology and data are core drivers of success in modern retail operations. As a Database Developer, you’ll play a central role in streamlining our data infrastructure and enhancing operational efficiency across all departments. You'll be working in a collaborative environment with room for growth and innovation.

We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued and included. We offer a competitive salary, an annual bonus based on company performance, healthcare and wellbeing programmes, pension plan membership, and shares and savings programme.


We embrace modern work practises; our Performance with Choice programme offers a hybrid working model, empowering you to find the optimal balance between remote and in\-office work.


Discover more about our company wide benefits and life at GSK on our webpage *Life at GSK \| GSK*

**In this role you will**

* Lead high\-quality statistical analysis and reporting in accordance with regulatory and internal guidance. Typical applications include planning and evaluation of experiments, sample size calculation, process and method validation, assay or process transfers, assay or process trending and root cause analysis investigations.
* Use a wide range of statistical methodologies including statistical process control, equivalence testing, linear modelling, design of experiments, acceptance sampling, multivariate methods and modelling using frequentist and Bayesian approaches.
* Act as an essential partner within international cross\-functional project teams by providing critical statistical support to route cause investigations. Provide statistical expertise to the team and help them interpret statistical outputs to use alongside other scientific understanding to champion data driven decisions aligned to GSK values.
* Work closely with colleagues in R\&D on new products to ensure a smooth knowledge transfer whilst providing instrumental support to enable the launch of new products to market.
* Ensure integrity of statistical evaluation by ensuring application of appropriate statistical methodologies and traceability / reproducibility.
* Ensure compliance of data analyses with internal and external requirements (e.g. GSK QMS, GSK SOPs, Ph.Eur., ICH/FDA guideline).
* Monitor and assess new developments, industry trends, evolving regulatory expectations. Constantly standardise and refine statistics in order to ensure application of state\-of\-the\-art statistical methodologies.
* Coach, mentor and train non\-statisticians as required on the appropriate use of statistical methodologies and data evaluation tools for their business processes. Train and coach less experienced associates in the group and the organisation.
* Actively participate with the global statistical community of GSK to develop, align and standardise data evaluation methods, methodologies and conventions.

***Why you?***

**Basic Qualifications \& Skills:**

**We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:**

* Masters degree in statistics, biostatistics or Bachelors degree in statistics, biostatistics with significant relevant experience
* Experience in statistical consulting, working alongside non\-statistical colleagues to devise practical statistical solutions for inquiries, ideally within a pharmaceutical manufacturing setting
* Knowledge of statistical methodology in several of the following areas: Statistical process control, acceptance sampling, experimental design (DOE), linear regression, analysis of variance (ANOVA), measurement systems analysis (MSA), variance components analysis, equivalence analysis, tolerance intervals, mixed models, Monte Carlo simulation, Bayesian methodology, and analysis of high\-dimensional data (MVA)
* Experience in the use of statistical software (e.g. Statistica or JMP) including at least one programming language (e.g. R)

**Preferred Qualifications \& Skills:**

**Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply:**

* PhD in statistics, biostatistics, or a closely related field with formal statistical training
* Excellent oral and written English communication skills
* Knowledge of core API and drug product tests, unit operations and product control strategies across multiple dose forms
* Experience of communicating complex information in logical and simplified terms at different levels
* Ability to independently manage workload and communications with stakeholders

**Closing Date for Applications – 24th July 2025 (COB)**


Please take a copy of the Job Description, as this will not be available post closure of the advert.  

When applying for this role, please use the ‘cover letter’ of the online application or your CV to describe how you meet the competencies for this role, as outlined in the job requirements above. The information that you have provided in your cover letter and CV will be used to assess your application.

 **Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together – so we can positively impact the health of billions of people and deliver stronger, more sustainable shareholder returns – as an organisation where people can thrive. We prevent and treat disease with vaccines, specialty and general medicines. We focus on the science of the immune system and the use of new platform and data technologies, investing in four core therapeutic areas (infectious diseases, HIV, respiratory/ immunology and oncology).


Our success absolutely depends on our people. While getting ahead of disease together is about our ambition for patients and shareholders, it’s also about making GSK a place where people can thrive. We want GSK to be a place where people feel inspired, encouraged and challenged to be the best they can be. A place where they can be themselves – feeling welcome, valued, and included. Where they can keep growing and look after their wellbeing. So, if you share our ambition, join us at this exciting moment in our journey to get Ahead Together.


GSK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), military service or any basis prohibited under federal, state or local law.

description:
At Beyond, we power the business of Short Term Rentals through our cutting\-edge, full\-stack Revenue Management System. Venture\-backed, we pioneered this space and have grown to be the globally dominant leader \- obsessed with delivering value and performance to our customers. And the way we've been able to achieve those heights is our belief that People are the most important part of any business \- starting with ours. We employ over 180 Beyonders across the globe who share in our commitment to making Beyond the best place to work.


It's with that in mind that Beyond is looking to add a Senior Data Scientist to our growing Engineering team. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will have the opportunity to leverage AI, ML, and statistical techniques to innovate on the core product at Beyond \- our dynamic pricing algorithm for short term rentals. You’ll work closely with experts from Revenue Management as well as data engineers to identify, design, test and implement improvements using a modern data processing workflow and tools.



Before reading further...



Beyond is passionate about diversity and cultivating our team’s potential. If you’re hungry for a good opportunity, but don't meet every point in this job description, please apply anyway!


#### **Our Engineering team believes in:**


* **Reducing scope** \- The best way to control progress and test hypotheses is to prevent scope creep;
* **Shipping early** \- The best way to learn early is to ship early. No need to be perfect;
* **Iterating and improving** \- Once we get the feedback we need, we iterate and improve;
* **Taking ownership** \- The code we ship is our responsibility as we know it best, and we also take care of sharing knowledge so others can support it;
* **Driving revenue** \- By focusing on providing the best customer experience, we improve acquisition and retention and drive growth for our customers and for us.


As our **Senior Data Scientist**, you'll be responsible for:


* Collaborating with your cross\-functional peers from Revenue Management, Product, Design, and Engineering on an outcome\-based team to craft and deliver on OKRs related to dynamic pricing recommendations and analysis for the short term rental industry.
* Designing to ensure solutions are deeply informed by user needs, measurable outcomes, and aligned with Beyond’s product vision.
* Working closely with data engineers to design, build, test, and maintain data pipelines, ensuring production readiness, and deploying scalable solutions.
* Driving the application of modern AI technologies, such as RAG, MCP, and embedding\-based semantic search to accelerate internal tooling and improve user\-facing intelligence.
* Integrating observability, monitoring, and human feedback collection into ML pipelines and agentic systems to continuously improve model performance and user alignment.
* Applying tools like LangChain and other orchestration frameworks to prototype and ship LLM\-powered assistants, agents, and automations that enhance customer decision\-making.
* Mentoring fellow Data Scientists and championing best practices in experimentation, validation (e.g. A/B testing, synthetic controls), and interpretability.


So what kind of person are we looking for in this role? The person who will be successful in this role will be:


* **Curious** \- You are driven to understand how things work or why they don't. You are interested in finding out how your work impacts our customers and the world they live in.
* **Collaborative** \- You enjoy exploring and committing as a team, you welcome others' ideas, and you value teamwork and team decision\-making over being right and having things going your way.
* **Result\-oriented** \- You manage the trade\-offs between speed and quality and are able to find the right balance. You would rather ship, measure, learn and iterate, rather than code the perfect component on the first try.
* **Resilient** \- You can adapt and roll up your sleeves to help others. You operate at a stable pace with visibility most of the time and you are ready to embrace change when it happens.
* **Proactive** \- You take initiative to identify opportunities and drive projects forward with minimal direction, independently navigating ambiguity to deliver impactful results.

  



Now that we’ve told you what the job looks like, here are the qualifications we're looking for in a candidate:


* 5\+ years of experience as a Data Scientist and 10\+ years in SaaS overall, preferably in high\-scale, multi\-tenant platforms.
* Proven expertise in machine learning and statistical modeling, with a track record of delivering models that meaningfully move product or revenue metrics.
* Fluency with Python and tools such as pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn, statsmodels, scipy, Spark, SQL, Streamlit, or other common data science frameworks.
* A strong product orientation, seeking to understand customer behavior, measure impact, and co\-create value with cross\-functional partners.
* An experimental mindset, with familiarity in designing and interpreting causal inference frameworks (e.g., A/B tests, synthetic controls).
* Hands\-on experience with modern AI techniques and tooling, including vector search, embeddings, RAG pipelines, LangChain, and model observability platforms is a plus.
* Located in Brazil or Peru
* Experience in revenue management, dynamic pricing, or the short term rental industry is a strong plus.


So what can you expect after you apply? Your application will be personally reviewed by a member of the Beyond hiring team and if there is a match in your experience and the role, you will:


* Have a video conversation with someone on our Recruiting team. This is a high\-level conversation about your experience and interest, but also an opportunity for you to learn more about us
* Meet with our VP of Engineering
* Meet with our Product Manager
* Complete a technical take home challenge
* Review the technical challenge and complete a technical interview with our Data Science team
* Meet with your potential direct manager
**Company Values:**



We are serious about our core values: We Care, We Are On the Same Team, We Inspire Trust, We Go Beyond, We Ship It, We're Curious. If those resonate with you, and you're ready to work with a team that lives and breathes those values, we want to hear from you.

  

**Benefits:**



Beyond offers a wide variety of benefits like: stock options, unlimited PTO, private health insurance and more! You can learn more about our benefits by visiting our careers site!


**We Care about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:**



Beyond is committed to building a workplace that attracts humans of all genders, ethnicities, backgrounds, statuses and lifestyles. At our core, we care about our people and encourage every employee, partner and applicant to share their whole self with us. We are respectful of and empathetic towards different viewpoints, and believe that our ability to help short term rental managers succeed relies on us building a dynamic and diverse team. Whoever you are, you can Belong @ Beyond.



Any communication regarding job openings, interviews and/or offers will come from our @beyondpricing.com email domain
